messages.content:
<document id=DOC_req_open_enum>
Required: PostgreSQL, Redis or similar databases.
</document>

State whether the candidate meets the requirement below, and say whether
you matched a named item or judged something equivalent.

response.text:
The candidate does not match a named item. MySQL is neither PostgreSQL nor Redis.

It can be judged partly equivalent: MySQL is a similar relational SQL database to PostgreSQL, so it fits the “or similar databases” clause for that part of the requirement, but it is not similar to Redis.
